args: r="${ORBIT_MCP_ROLE:-agent}"; case "$r" in operator) exec orbit mcp serve --mode federated --operator ;; manager|resident|agent|reader) exec orbit mcp serve --mode federated --role "$r" ;; *) echo "orbit mcp: unknown ORBIT_MCP_ROLE '$r' (operator, manager, resident, agent, reader)" >&2; exit 64 ;; esac
